notes: Fixes false ECONOMY/RANGED classification on meaningful enemies. A non-caster is now considered obvious trash only when it is at least 2 HD below the companion AND has at most 50% of the companion's max HP; when both CR values are usable, target CR must also be <=60% of companion CR. The same strict rule now drives combat economy, premium-ammo conservation, close-threat trash substitution, and NUI economy display. This intentionally favors spending real combat resources over misclassifying a dangerous mod/story enemy as weak. NUI respec display 0.8.6.32, hidden helpers 0.8.6.31, Dorna 0.8.6.30, somatic 0.8.6.29, companion discipline 0.8.6.28, reader 0.8.6.26, protected combat core 0.7.10.7, familiar FIX5/progression and PRC_MULTISUMMON are otherwise unchanged.
